personal_repos.name: plot
personal_repos.description: Plot is a Figma-style canvas for pull request review. Each PR opens as a board of visual blocks: intent, architecture, change cards with before/after flows, an alternatives carousel showing what else could have been built, risk flags, and the diff. Built for reviewing AI-generated code. Next.js + React Flow + OpenAI. Paris AI Hackathon 2026.

personal_repos.name: float
personal_repos.description: Peer-to-peer payments app. Send money to friends, view your activity feed, stay in control with daily spending limits. Monorepo: Express + Prisma + Postgres backend (api/), vanilla JS + Tailwind frontend (web/). Bearer-token auth. Shipping v0.2: self-serve transfers and per-user spend caps. Backend and web move in lockstep, one feature at a time.

personal_repos.name: gladia-python-sdk
personal_repos.description: Unofficial Python SDK for Gladia — A developer-friendly toolkit to integrate Gladia’s real-time and batch audio transcription APIs into your Python applications. Provides simple file transcription, ergonomic streaming helpers, audio source utilities, and reliable event handling with sane defaults.

personal_repos.name: data-warehouse-educational-project
personal_repos.description: This project builds a data warehouse for four years of e-commerce sales. It uses Talend for ETL and stores data in PostgreSQL. The goal is to analyze revenue, profits, shipping delays, and returns.

personal_repos.name: network-security-aes
personal_repos.description: This project provides a Java implementation of AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) encryption algorithm. AES is a symmetric key encryption algorithm widely used for securing sensitive data.

personal_repos.name: network-security-ccm
personal_repos.description: This project provides a Java implementation of Counter with CBC-MAC (CCM) mode for AES encryption and decryption. CCM mode combines Counter (CTR) mode for encryption with CBC-MAC for tag generation, supporting additional authenticated data (AAD) along with plaintext.
